claim_boundary: A positive result supports cross-dataset transport of one frozen coding-agent trajectory profile. It does not establish causality, universal Coherence Dynamics, human handoff correction prediction, Phi-star, VKD, or the Terrynce Curve.
modeling: No external fitting, feature selection, hyperparameter selection, threshold tuning, or calibration. Apply source-fitted imputer, scaler, coefficients, intercepts, and source thresholds unchanged.
primary_metric: PR-AUC delta: frozen simple-plus-CD minus frozen simple
primary_question: Does the frozen Nebius 75%-horizon simple-plus-CD profile improve prediction of independently evaluated coding-task success over the frozen simple profile on non-Nebius external trajectories?
